visualCharacteristics: BMW model comparison: 3 columns (cosy image, name, CTAs, price, series/model/engine selects), highlights, exterior/interior view, technical data accordions with "Nur Unterschiede anzeigen", footnotes, sticky header
contentPattern: Row 1: headline (h1); row 2: link to the source compare page. The app template (content.q?extract=compare) and model data (_jcr_content.technicaldata.*.json) are loaded through the bmw-proxy; selections from the URL hash #series/range/model/transmission (x3).
